thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: EU-WEST2 p99 streaming stalls and elevated tail latency detected. SLO breach(rolling 5m). Auto-escalation to oncall.
oncall-ryan: I’m on it — paging SRE lead @sre-jo and runtime @eng-runtime-maya. Any visible deploys? :eyes:
sre-jo: @oncall-ryan seeing p95 ~ 420ms, p99 spikes to ~3.2s for streaming endpoints. Non-streaming gen also up ~30% on p99. No deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.
eng-runtime-maya: checking router / lb metrics now. Initial look: request routing in eu-west2 shows heavy tail on a subset of shards, looks like hot partitioning to a handful of hosts.
infra-lee: logs show repeated 502s from shard-proxy-7 in eu-west2-a around the spike. Not full errors, but connection resets and longer connect times.
cs-anna: flagged by two paying customers (acct: acme-media, acct: learninc) seeing streaming stalls and timeouts in prod. They're on us now, pinged them acknowledging incident.
oncall-ryan: quick mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic from eu-west2-a to eu-west2-b/c, 2) eject shard-proxy-7, 3) scale up healthy pool for streaming. Can infra do a quick ejection? :pray:
infra-lee: eject started for shard-proxy-7 -> traffic draining. I’m bumping capacity +2 nodes in eu-west2. ETA ~2m for warmup.
sre-jo: creating a temporary routing override to avoid eu-west2-a for streaming routes. Adding fallback to lower-capacity variant to avoid stalls for low-latency traffic.
eng-runtime-maya: confirming routing policy oddness: weight calculation for region skewing recently changed in rollout (policy v2.14) — looks like a bug where heavy prefix keys push >80% weight to one hot zone. Reproducing locally.
oncall-ryan: that explains hot partition. Is rollback safe for policy v2.14? Any knock-on risk?
eng-runtime-maya: can patch quick config to revert to v2.13 logic for weight smoothing. Patch prepared, requires approval from infra/ops. Will push as config-only change (no binary deploy).
pm-maya: (prod impact) prioritizing rollback — two customers with streaming timeouts, broader SLO breach persists. Please communicate ETA to CS.
infra-lee: config rollback applied to routing controlplane; new weights propagating. Observability: p99 dropping from 3.2s -> 1.1s in first 60s, p95 back near baseline. Streaming stalls reduced but still seeing intermittent tail at ~900ms.
cs-anna: telling customers: "We’ve implemented an immediate routing rollback and are monitoring. Expect improvement in next 5 minutes. We’ll follow up with root cause and timeline." They responded: "Thanks, please keep us posted. Some sessions timed out and need replays."
sre-jo: digging into why shard-proxy-7 had resets — probing healthchecks and connection pool exhaustion. Heap/FDs look ok; metrics show sustained high concurrent streams for hot keys.
eng-runtime-maya: confirmed: a policy bug plus hot key skew (prefix traffic from a small set of customer jobs) caused overloaded streaming workers which increased queueing and TCP resets. Mitigation: weight smoothing + transient hotkey backpressure.
oncall-ryan: next steps: 1) keep routing rollback for 30m, 2) add temporary hotkey throttling rules for top 0.1% prefixes, 3) postmortem owner? Assign to eng-runtime-maya + sre-jo.
pm-maya: agree on owners. Also assign customer follow-up to cs-anna for impact summaries and possible credits.
sre-jo: setting escalation ticket INC-2468 and marking severity: Sev2 (customer impact, partial outage to streaming SLOs). Will collect traces and p99 histograms.
eng-runtime-maya: posting quick diagnostic snippets for post-incident: ```
# top hot prefixes (eu-west2)
prefix_counts = ["acct:acme-media:stream": 12345, "acct:learninc:ai": 11200, "acct:smalllabs:video": 9800]
# routing weight calc (v2.14)
def calc_weight(shard_loads):
    # buggy smoothing divisor
    return max(1, int(sum(shard_loads)/1))
# temporary fix: divide by 4 for smoothing
```
infra-lee: monitoring continues. No full customer-facing errors now, just degraded tail for a short window. Will keep capacity +2 until end of the hour.
oncall-ryan: handing off to night oncall @sre-jo for monitoring and postmortem. I’ll update the incident channel and notify execs.
sre-jo: taking over. Will keep rollback in place and collect artifacts: router logs, kernel TCP resets, per-shard qdepth, and routing decision traces. Planning postmortem doc entry.
cs-anna: I'll draft customer-impact notes and include affected request IDs for replays where possible.
pm-maya: thanks team. Please include timeline and the config diff in the postmortem. Also note the policy rollout process gap — need gate for weight-smoothing changes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (2468013579): Mitigation applied (routing rollback + ejection). P99 improved from 3.2s -> 1.0s over 2m. Incident status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Assigned owners: eng-runtime-maya, sre-jo.
